item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Troopers arrest four after alleged street takeover, 140 mph chase on I-75: FHP
item.description: Four people were arrested after troopers said they took part in a street takeover on Interstate 75 that led to a high-speed chase reaching 140 mph, according to Florida Highway Patrol (FHP).
